faq_heading: Homes near Cougar Creek Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Cougar Creek Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Cougar Creek Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Cougar Creek Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Cougar Creek Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 47 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,099,800, townhomes $652,500, condos $476,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Cougar Creek Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Cougar Creek Elementary the median was 46 days on the market, closing at 95.6% of the list price, with 13% of sales above the list price for the 47 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Cougar Creek Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Khalsa School Newton (0.3 km south-east), Beaver Creek Elementary (1.1 km south) and Westerman Elementary (1.2 km north).

Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Cougar Creek Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Cougar Creek Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Cougar Creek Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Cougar Creek Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 47 homes sold within 1 km of Cougar Creek Elementary: 29 houses, 10 townhomes and 7 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,099,800.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Cougar Creek Elementary

30 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Cougar Creek Elementary in a straight line (21 elementary, 7 secondary, 2 other; 4 independent). The closest is Khalsa School Newton, 0.3 km away, and the farthest on this list is Kennedy Trail Elementary, 2.6 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Tamanawis Secondary (1.2 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Sunshine Hills Elementary (2.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Khalsa School Newton (0.3 km south-east), Beaver Creek Elementary (1.1 km south), Westerman Elementary (1.2 km north), Strawberry Hill Elementary (1.2 km north), Cougar Canyon Elementary (1.3 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Khalsa School Newton, 0.3 km south-east of Cougar Creek Elementary.
